[EN] Mission Orders

The barsicore Yunaras Snaggletooth has developed a taste for amani flesh. To protect amani civilians and soldiers in the Plain of the Damned, this monster must be eliminated.

Hunt and destroy the barsicore.

Report to Raneria in Habere when the mission is complete.
[ES] Orden de misión

El barsicore Yunaras Snaggletooth le ha tomado el gusto a la carne amani. Para proteger a los civiles y soldados amani en Plain of the Damned, este monstruo debe ser eliminado.

Caza y destruye al barsicore.

Preséntate ante Raneria en Habere cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] Here's your reward, as well as the Valkyon Federation's gratitude!
[ES] ¡Aquí tienes tu recompensa, así como la gratitud de la Valkyon Federation!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
